composition_subtypes.role: Sliding window minimum using deque to precompute min for each length-k window
1D DP to select non-overlapping windows maximizing sum of removed minima

payload.core_composition_summary: Deque computes sliding window minima; DP picks non-overlapping windows via segtree max queries to maximize removed sum.
payload.rationale: Deque maintains monotonic queue for O(n) window minima. DP transition uses segment tree to query max over previous non-overlapping windows.
